{{Quote|This must be where the Nightbrothers live.|Cal Kestis|audio=CalKestis-ThisMustBeWhereTheNightbrothersLive.flac|<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />}}
A '''Nightbrother village''' was the residence of [[Viscus' clan]] of the [[Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak]] warrior group, the [[Nightbrothers]], on the [[planet]] [[Dathomir]]. Built into the side of the [[Upper Strangled Cliffs]], the village was also home to the Nightbrothers' domesticated [[Bane Back Spider|bane back spider]]s. [[Jedi Master]] [[Taron Malicos]] crash-landed on the planet around the [[time]] of the execution of [[Order 66]], and he was brought to the village by Nightbrothers, becoming entangled with the clan's affairs.

[[Standard year|Years]] later, while trying to reach the [[Zeffo]] [[Tomb of Kujet]], [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Cal Kestis]] found himself knocked into the depths of Dathomir. On a journey to make his way back to the surface, he passed through the village and learned the story of Malicos and the [[Nightbrothers]].

==Description==
Located on<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Outer Rim">''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[planet]] [[Dathomir]], a village was built into the [[Upper Strangled Cliffs]] and was encased by big [[wood]]en walls and towers. The village was inhabited by the [[Dathomirian]] [[Zabrak]] warrior group known as the [[Nightbrothers]], specifically the [[Viscus' clan|clan]] headed by Brother [[Viscus]]. A [[metal]] drawbridge—which could be raised in order to prevent outsiders from entering the village—over a large gap led to a narrow [[stone]] door entrance. Beneath the village was a [[Nightbrother Dungeon|dungeon]] used by the Nightbrothers, and nearby was a path leading to the [[Swamp of Sacrifice]]. Inside the village, wooden cages hung from the ceiling, [[Fire|torches]] lit up the village, and homes lined with [[Dathomirian Glyphs]] were carved into the side of the rock walls.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />

==History==
===Creation and rise of Malicos===
{{Quote|We have sacrificed too many, he's too dangerous. We should kill him!|One Nightbrother discusses the Taron Malicos problem|audio=NightbrotherWeShouldKillHim.flac|<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />}}
[[File:Droids-Second-Battle-of-Dathomir.png|thumb|left|250px|The destruction of the Nightbrothers' prior village]]
In [[19 BBY]],<ref name="Creation Date">In [[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 4|''Darth Maul—Son of Dathomir'' 4]], the [[Nightbrother village]] inhabited by [[Viscus' clan]] is destroyed during the [[Second Battle of Dathomir]], which ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]. ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' shows that Viscus' clan has established a new village by the [[time]] of [[Order 66]], which ''Timelines'' also dates to 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]]. Thus, the new village must have been established in that [[Standard year|year]].</ref> the Nightbrothers' [[Nightbrother village|prior village]] was destroyed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Second Battle of Dathomir]] in a [[Campaign against the Shadow Collective|campaign]] against the [[Shadow Collective]].<ref name="Son of Dathomir 4">[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 4|''Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir'' 4]]</ref> After the battle, the surviving Nightbrothers retreated and built a new village,<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" /> which they would finish that same year.<ref name="Creation Date" />

Later that [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="Creation Date" /> the Nightbrothers living in the village witnessed the [[Starship|ship]] of [[Jedi Master]] [[Taron Malicos]] crash-land in the Swamp of Sacrifice after [[Supreme Chancellor]] of the [[Galactic Republic]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] executed [[Order 66]], a special order of the Galactic Republic that aimed to wipe out all [[Jedi]]. When the Nightbrothers went to inspect the ship, [[Nightsisters|Nightsister]] [[Merrin]] urged caution, as she [[Force sense|sensed]] something dangerous. In the ship, they found the former Jedi who they apprehended and brought to the village. The strong presence of the [[dark side of the Force]] began to drive Malicos insane, and he abandoned the teachings of the Jedi in order to embrace the dark side. Nightbrothers in the village eventually became tired of waiting for Merrin's instructions and, without her permission, chased Malicos through a [[Collapsed Settlement]] and eventually recaptured him, although he killed one Nightbrother in the process. Due to this tragedy, some Nightbrothers plotted to [[Death|kill]] the fallen Jedi as revenge for the lost lives. Brought to Brother Viscus by the Nightbrothers, Malicos fought Viscus and killed him, seizing control of the Nightbrothers and allying with Merrin and promising vengeance for the [[Battle of Dathomir|massacre]] of her sisters<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" /> in [[20 BBY]].<ref name="BoD date">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref>

===Visit by Cal Kestis===
{{Quote|I'm coming out of a Nightbrother village now. Hoping to get back on track.|Cal Kestis, to his companion Cere Junda|audio=ImComingOutOfANightbrotherVillage.flac|<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />}}
[[File:CalFacesMerrinKujet.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Padawan Cal Kestis visited the village during the reign of the Galactic Empire.]]
By [[14 BBY]],<ref name="JFO date note">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'' to [[14 BBY]].</ref> the Nightbrothers had learned how to domesticate [[Bane Back Spider|bane back spider]]s that would reside with them in the village.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" /> That year,<ref name="JFO date note" /> Jedi [[Padawan]] [[Cal Kestis]] was visiting Dathomir to retrieve an [[astrium]] from the [[Tomb of Kujet]], the [[burial]] site of the [[Zeffo Sage]] [[Kujet]]. Knocked down from the [[Treacherous Approach]] by a Nightbrother who threw a large rock to destabilize the area Kestis was standing on, the Padawan fell into the depths of Dathomir and traveled through the wilderness in an attempt to find his way back to the surface and reach the tomb.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />

When Kestis reached the village, he was shot at by Nightbrothers using [[Nightsister energy bow]]s, and the Padawan was forced to retreat into the Swamp of Sacrifice. After finally making it back to the entrance, he climbed into the dungeon using the underside of the lowered drawbridge. He then climbed up the dungeon into the main area of the village, where he engaged in combat with the Nightbrothers, eventually defeating them. [[Telekinesis|Pulling]] a cage down from a raised platform with [[the Force]], Kestis used the cage to propel himself up and through a passageway so he could continue his journey.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />

{{GameMechanics|Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order}}
While in the village, Kestis used the Force ability of [[Psychometry]] to learn the story of Malicos and the Nightbrothers. From a chest, Kestis acquired the necessary paint for the “Aphelion” paint job for [[luxury yacht]]s.<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />
{{EndGame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Nightbrother village appeared in the [[2019]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Jedi: Fallen Order]]'', developed by [[Respawn Entertainment]].<ref name="Jedi Fallen Order" />
